title: Oncoskill Action Board
description: The live list of concrete next actions. The skill keeps it short and every action has an owner, a reason, and (when relevant) an escalation condition.

owner.description: Who does it (patient / caregiver / a named person).

blocking_dependency.description: What this is waiting on (e.g. 'PET result', 'clinic reply').

escalation_condition.description: When/how to escalate if it stalls (e.g. 'no reply by <date> -> phone secretariat, then de-escalation playbook').

source.description: Where this action came from (a document, a visit debrief, an evidence claim_id).

provenance.description: Audit trail — never silently rewrite history. Append an entry on each meaningful change.

source.description: what prompted it (a document, a visit debrief, a claim_id)
